status: Open — catalog blind spot and invalid case ids repaired; Plan 4.0 closure re-verification still open
area: Evidence / Test Catalog / Plan 4.0 certification integrity
finding: The full-catalog validator is blind to 42 percent of the catalog and reports success anyway. tests/catalog/groups holds 23 shard files using five different schemaId values: atm.testCaseGroup.v1 (12 files, the only value normalizeGroupShard accepts), plus atm.testCatalogGroupShard.v1, atm.testGroupShard.v1, atm.testCatalogShard.v1 and atm.testCatalogGroup.v1 (11 files). normalizeGroupShard returns null for the other four schemaIds with no error, no warning and no diagnostic, so loadTestCaseGroupShards silently returns 12 of 23 shards and 18 of 43 case ids are never validated. Some unreachable shards also store ids in a caseIds string array instead of cases[].caseId, so a shape-unaware scan under-counts them further. Eight schema-invalid case ids are hiding inside the unreachable region, belonging to ATM-GOV-0280, ATM-GOV-0284, ATM-GOV-0285 and ATM-GOV-0306.
expectedBehavior: A full-catalog validation run must observe every shard file on disk. A shard that cannot be normalized must fail closed with an explicit diagnostic naming the file and its schemaId; it must never be silently dropped. Catalog green must mean every declared case id was actually checked.
evidenceOrRepro: node --strip-types -e "import('./packages/core/src/evidence/test-case-catalog.ts').then(m=>console.log(m.loadTestCaseGroupShards(process.cwd()).length))" -> 12, against 23 files present in tests/catalog/groups. reportShardReachability (added by ATM-GOV-0313) enumerates the 11 unreachable shards and the 18 hidden case ids. Before ATM-GOV-0313 the shard test exited 0 while skipping all of them.
impact: This undermines the evidentiary basis of the Plan 4.0 completed boundary rather than merely adding a gap. ATM-GOV-0306 is the load-bearing case: the captain handoff certifies it as done/released with all five closure-required validators fresh, but both of its requiredTestCaseIds live in test_group_plan4_mutation_lineage, which uses atm.testCatalogGroup.v1 and is unreachable. Its closure packet was therefore produced by a validator that never read its shard. The same holds for ATM-GOV-0280, ATM-GOV-0284 and ATM-GOV-0285. Any Plan 3.x/4.0 matrix row whose evidence tuple depends on a full-catalog validator receipt must stay not-complete until this item is closed; a green catalog command is not admissible evidence in the meantime.
containment: ATM-GOV-0313 did not repair the 11 shards, because they are sealed deliverables of other closed cards and the captain handoff forbids amending the delivered 0306 lane in place. Instead 0313 added reportShardReachability in packages/core/src/evidence/test-case-catalog.ts and a frozen known-debt register in tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts. The register pins the exact 11 unreachable groupIds and the total of 18 hidden case ids under set equality, so the blind spot cannot grow: any new shard added with a non-accepted schemaId fails the test immediately, and any repair forces the register to shrink deliberately. The register is shrink-only and entries may not be added without owner approval. 2026-08-27 repair: the reachability half is closed — reportShardReachability now returns 50 of 50 shards reachable with 0 hidden case ids, and the frozen UNREACHABLE_SHARD_REGISTER in tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts has shrunk to empty with EXPECTED_HIDDEN_CASE_ID_TOTAL 0. Exposing those shards left five schema-invalid case ids failing the raw shard schema at HEAD (test_six_editor_sealed_source_parity_0338, test_independent_certificate_fail_closed_dimensions_0341, test_release_closeback_digest_parity_0341, test_plan4_foundation_topology_and_17_anchors_0336, test_real_same_candidate_shadow_0337). Those five are now migrated onto the canonical test_task_atm_gov_<card>_<descriptor>_<digest8> namespace, and each shard carries a legacyAliases lineage row so the sealed requiredTestCaseIds of ATM-GOV-0336, 0337, 0338 and 0341 keep resolving without editing any closed card record. node --strip-types tests/cli/plan4-catalog-contract.test.ts, tests/cli/test-case-catalog-shards.test.ts and tests/cli/plan-3x-4x-validator-profile-coverage.test.ts all pass.
followUp: Open a dedicated catalog-reachability repair card with explicit authority over the affected closed cards' shards. It must normalise the five schemaId variants and the two case-id shapes onto one canonical contract, migrate the eight remaining invalid ids through the same legacyAliases lineage mechanism so no closed card's sealed evidence is edited, make unknown schemaIds fail closed in normalizeGroupShard, shrink the frozen register to empty, and then re-verify the closure evidence of ATM-GOV-0280, 0284, 0285 and 0306 against a validator that actually reads their shards. Do not certify Plan 4.0 or downgrade the overall NOT COMPLETE verdict before that re-verification exists. 2026-08-27 remaining scope: the namespace and lineage repair is done, so what stays open is the evidentiary re-verification only — re-run the closure evidence of ATM-GOV-0280, 0284, 0285 and 0306 against the now-complete catalog and decide the Plan 4.0 verdict from that run. Do not treat the green focused catalog contract as that re-verification.
